support_current.charge_description: charged every 4 hours on open positions

evaluation_terms_current.swap_rule: If an open swap position exists at 00:00 UTC, a daily swap fee of 0.033% per open swap position is deducted from the Demo Account balance at that time.

funded_terms_current.swap_rule: If an open swap position exists at 00:00 UTC, a daily swap fee of 0.033% per open swap position is deducted from the Funded Account balance at 00:25 UTC.

kraken_prop.material_conflict: The current Kraken support description of six funding charges per day is not operationally equivalent to the current governing Breakout legal text describing one daily 0.033% swap fee tied to the 00:00 UTC open-position state, with the funded agreement specifying deduction at 00:25 UTC. Cost timing and potentially cumulative charge amount materially affect 12H/1D positions and drawdown paths.
kraken_prop.remaining_execution_blocker: No authoritative frozen historical executable Kraken Prop bid/ask/liquidity fill stream exists for the setup replay windows.

evaluation_terms_current.agreement: Breakout Evaluation Agreement Annex B Section 2 Kraken Consumer Prop

funded_terms_current.agreement: Funded Trader Agreement Annex C Kraken Funded Users
funded_terms_current.rule_reference: states Kraken Funded uses Funded Account balances, Maximum Daily Loss Limits and Maximum Drawdown Limits set out in Annex B

kraken_funded_consumer_prop.material_conflict: Current support and current legal agreements do not provide a single internally consistent max-loss/daily-loss specification for Kraken Funded. The support describes a fixed 3% total loss line; the current evaluation contract specifies 3% MDL plus 5% MDD for Kraken Consumer Prop purchases on/after 2026-08-25; the funded contract cross-references Annex B mechanics in a way that does not resolve this conflict cleanly.
kraken_funded_consumer_prop.execution_conflict: The current product is mobile-only, 1x and without advanced order types. Current legal terms restrict Consumer Prop to market buy/sell orders. Frozen Donchian persistent stop/target semantics cannot be assumed operationally equivalent without changing execution behavior.

ftmo.dh03_blocker: BNBUSD and SOLUSD were introduced as new FTMO crypto CFDs effective in July 2025, so an exact six-symbol FTMO replay of DH-03 over 2023-2024 cannot exist without changing the frozen universe.
ftmo.carry_blocker: FTMO states overnight rollover swaps are subject to regular changes and must be checked in current contract specifications; no authoritative historical swap series for the required windows is frozen.

campaign_decision.reason: Every current prop path retains at least one material rule/source/execution ambiguity that affects HTF drawdown, carry, instrument availability, or exact execution. Campaign governance requires fail-closed rather than choosing a favorable interpretation.
